synopsis: EN ISO 16001:2017 is the European adoption of ISO 16001:2017, as stated in both Chapter 3 and the glossary [f2179, f2210, f15205]. The glossary places it within the EN standards framework published by CEN and CENELEC, where many standards adopt ISO texts [f15020]. ISO 16001:2017 is edition 2 and was confirmed in 2023; its Australian regional version is AS ISO 16001:2020 [f15205, f2179]. The supplied facts establish publication and adoption status, but do not specify acceptance criteria or validation requirements for this standard [f2179, f15020, f2210, f15205].

relations.note: Both identify the European and Australian versions of ISO 16001:2017.
Both identify EN ISO 16001:2017 as the European adoption.
Both establish EN ISO 16001:2017 as a European version.
Adds the EN publishing framework and ISO adoption context.
